column1: # Credits for the named rules in crates/jetcarp-core/data/rules/named.json, in our own words.
# Compiled 2026-11-10 from LifeWiki (List of Life-like rules, List of Generations rules, Larger than Life, OCA pages),
# Mirek Wójtowicz's MCell rules lexicon, Toffoli & Margolus (1987) and Wikipedia. Columns: name, notation,
# credit (empty when no source names a person), sources checked (LW:<page> = LifeWiki page, MC = MCell lexicon,
# CAM = Toffoli & Margolus 1987, WP:<page> = Wikipedia), status. Used by docs/tools/gen-named-rules.py.
